metadata.title: zERC20 Privacy Token Protocol - Remaining Properties Audit Checklist (Stage 2 - Batch 6 FINAL)
metadata.description: Final partial checklist for non-boundary properties. This batch covers remaining subgraph properties (Baby JubJub, IC, Stargate, Nova Folding, SelfCall, Native Token, Governance, lzCompose) and all critical system-wide security invariants.

checklist.title: Verify Baby JubJub curve operations are mathematically correct on BN254
checklist.description: Verify that point addition and scalar multiplication on the Baby JubJub twisted Edwards curve (embedded in BN254) produce mathematically correct results according to curve equation: ax^2 + y^2 = 1 + dx^2y^2.
detection_procedure: 1. Verify Baby JubJub curve parameters match standard (a=-1, d=168696/168700)
2. Test point addition with known test vectors
3. Test scalar multiplication correctness: [k]P computed correctly
4. Verify base point G is on curve and has expected order
5. Test edge cases: identity element, point at infinity, doubling

executable_checks.assertion: All BJJ operations match known test vectors

executable_checks.command: Verify curve parameters against audited library

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-SUBGRAPH-BJJ-001 -> Subgraph GRAPH-BABY-JUBJUB-OPERATIONS. TRUSTED: Uses audited library implementation. ECDLP hardness assumption on BN254-embedded curve.

checklist.title: Verify IC canister provides confidential key derivation via vetKd
checklist.description: Verify that IC canister interactions correctly derive encryption keys using vetKd canister and that encrypted state storage via AES-GCM protects user data confidentiality.
detection_procedure: 1. Review IC agent creation and authentication
2. Verify vetKd canister call for key derivation
3. Confirm AES-GCM encryption mode with proper nonce handling
4. Test that derived keys are unique per user/context
5. Verify encrypted state cannot be decrypted without derived key

executable_checks.assertion: Key derivation uses vetKd with proper parameters

executable_checks.command: dfx deploy && dfx canister call test_key_derivation

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-SUBGRAPH-IC-001 -> Subgraph GRAPH-IC-CANISTER-INTERACTION. SEMI_TRUSTED per trust model. AES-GCM encryption. IC infrastructure trust boundary.

checklist.title: Verify Stargate bridge enforces slippage protection and handles refunds
checklist.description: Verify that Stargate bridge flow validates minAmountOut slippage parameter and correctly routes failed transactions (slippage exceeded) to the refund path.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate Stargate send call and minAmountOut parameter
2. Verify minAmountOut is user-specified or calculated with tolerance
3. Test transaction where slippage exceeds minAmountOut -> refund triggered
4. Verify refund path correctly returns tokens to original sender
5. Test fee quote accuracy matches actual execution cost

executable_checks.assertion: User cannot receive less than minAmountOut

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-SUBGRAPH-STARGATE-001 -> Subgraph GRAPH-STARGATE-BRIDGE-FLOW. Stargate minAmountOut enforcement. Refund mechanism on slippage failure.

checklist.title: Verify Nova folding scheme maintains IVC soundness
checklist.description: Verify that Nova folding correctly accumulates proofs using relaxed R1CS while preserving IVC soundness - ensuring no invalid proof can be folded into a valid accumulator.
detection_procedure: 1. Verify sonobe/folding-schemes library version and audit status
2. Review Nova IVC fold operation implementation
3. Confirm relaxed R1CS constraints preserved across folds
4. Test: invalid intermediate proof -> fold fails
5. Verify accumulator verification catches corrupted state

executable_checks.assertion: Invalid proofs cannot be folded successfully

executable_checks.command: Verify sonobe library version against known CVEs

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-SUBGRAPH-NOVA-FOLDING-001 -> Subgraph GRAPH-NOVA-FOLDING-SCHEME. TRUSTED: sonobe/folding-schemes library. Nova IVC soundness property.

checklist.title: Verify SelfCall pattern prevents external reentrancy
checklist.description: Verify that the onlySelfCall modifier correctly enforces both conditions: msg.sender == address(this) AND selfCallEnabled == true, preventing external callers from invoking protected functions.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate onlySelfCall modifier definition
2. Verify modifier checks: require(msg.sender == address(this) && selfCallEnabled)
3. Test external call to onlySelfCall function -> revert
4. Test internal call without selfCallEnabled -> revert
5. Verify selfCallEnabled is properly toggled around internal calls

executable_checks.assertion: External caller cannot invoke onlySelfCall functions

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-SUBGRAPH-SELFCALL-001 -> Subgraph GRAPH-SELFCALL-PATTERN. Reentrancy prevention via dual-condition check. Both msg.sender and selfCallEnabled required.

checklist.title: Verify native ETH handling validates msg.value and wraps correctly
checklist.description: Verify that native ETH handling validates msg.value matches expected amount, properly wraps ETH to WETH, and refunds any excess ETH to prevent funds being stuck in contract.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate all functions accepting msg.value
2. Verify msg.value validation: exact match or documented excess handling
3. Trace ETH -> WETH wrapping via WETH.deposit{value: amount}()
4. Verify excess ETH refund mechanism
5. Test: send more ETH than required -> excess refunded
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-SUBGRAPH-NATIVE-TOKEN-001 -> Subgraph GRAPH-NATIVE-TOKEN-HANDLING. msg.value validation prevents ETH stuck in contract. WETH wrapping for ERC20 compatibility.

checklist.title: Verify governance functions restricted by onlyOwner modifier
checklist.description: Verify that all administrative functions (setFeeParams, withdrawRewards, setVerifiers, registerToken, updateToken, setMinter, upgradeContract) are protected by onlyOwner modifier.
detection_procedure: 1. List all administrative/governance functions in contracts
2. Verify each has onlyOwner modifier
3. Test non-owner calling admin function -> revert
4. Verify owner() returns expected address
5. Check for any admin bypass mechanisms

executable_checks.assertion: All admin functions revert for non-owner

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-SUBGRAPH-GOVERNANCE-001 -> Subgraph GRAPH-GOVERNANCE-ADMIN-FUNCTIONS. OUT_OF_SCOPE per trust model - owner operations not in audit scope. Documented for completeness.

checklist.title: Verify lzCompose callback authenticates sender and validates Stargate origin
checklist.description: Verify that lzCompose callback enforces msg.sender == LayerZero endpoint AND validates _from address is a registered Stargate pool, preventing unauthorized compose calls.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate lzCompose function implementation
2. Verify first check: require(msg.sender == endpoint)
3. Verify second check: require(_from in registeredStargatePools)
4. Test compose call from non-endpoint address -> revert
5. Test compose call with unregistered _from address -> revert
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-SUBGRAPH-LZCOMPOSE-001 -> Subgraph GRAPH-STARGATE-LZCOMPOSE-CALLBACK. CRITICAL: Dual authentication required. Failed composes stored for retry, not silently dropped.

checklist.title: CRITICAL: Verify ZKP system maintains 128-bit security and soundness
checklist.description: Verify that the entire ZKP system (Nova IVC + Groth16 decider) maintains 128-bit computational security and cryptographic soundness - no attacker can forge a valid proof for a statement they cannot honestly prove.
detection_procedure: 1. Verify BN254 curve security level (128-bit under ECDLP)
2. Verify Groth16 trusted setup was performed correctly
3. Confirm Nova IVC accumulator verification catches invalid folds
4. Test forged proof submission -> verification rejects
5. Review constraint system completeness (all transitions constrained)

executable_checks.assertion: No missing constraints enabling proof forgery

checklist.notes: CRITICAL SYSTEM PROPERTY. Traceability: Property PROP-CRITICAL-001-ZKP-SOUNDNESS -> System-wide. All teleport security depends on ZKP soundness. Groth16 128-bit security + Nova IVC soundness. Breaking requires solving discrete log on BN254.

checklist.title: CRITICAL: Verify double-spend prevention via monotonic totalTeleported
checklist.description: Verify that no valid teleport proof can be executed twice - the monotonicity check on totalTeleported[recipient] ensures each proof encodes a strictly higher cumulative amount than previously processed.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate totalTeleported mapping in Verifier
2. Verify monotonicity check: require(proofAmount > totalTeleported[recipient])
3. Verify totalTeleported updated BEFORE minting tokens
4. Test: replay same proof -> revert on monotonicity
5. Test: submit proof with lower amount than previous -> revert

executable_checks.assertion: Second submission of same proof reverts

checklist.notes: CRITICAL SYSTEM PROPERTY. Traceability: Property PROP-CRITICAL-002-DOUBLE-SPEND-PREVENTION -> System-wide. totalTeleported is strictly increasing per recipient. Proof encodes cumulative amount, not delta. Re-submission mathematically fails monotonicity.

checklist.title: CRITICAL: Verify cross-chain message authentication via source EID
checklist.description: Verify that all cross-chain messages (root updates to Hub, global root updates to Verifier) are authenticated by validating the source endpoint ID (EID) against registered peers, preventing message injection attacks.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate all _lzReceive implementations (Hub, Verifier)
2. Verify each validates source EID before processing
3. Confirm peer registration is owner-controlled
4. Test message from unregistered EID -> rejected
5. Verify LayerZero guardian validation (13/19 supermajority)
checklist.notes: CRITICAL SYSTEM PROPERTY. Traceability: Property PROP-CRITICAL-003-CROSS-CHAIN-INTEGRITY -> System-wide. LayerZero guardian supermajority (13/19) provides message integrity at transport layer. EID validation provides application-layer authentication.

checklist.title: CRITICAL: Verify zERC20 minting restricted to authorized pathways only
checklist.description: Verify that zERC20 tokens can only be minted through two authorized pathways: LiquidityManager.mint() (for wrapping) and Verifier.teleport() (for cross-chain arrivals). No other address can invoke mint functions.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate mint() and teleport() functions in zERC20
2. Verify mint() restricted: require(msg.sender == minter())
3. Verify teleport() restricted: require(msg.sender == verifier())
4. Confirm minter() and verifier() set during deployment
5. Test: arbitrary address calls mint() -> revert

executable_checks.assertion: Only minter address can call mint()
Only verifier address can call teleport()

checklist.notes: CRITICAL SYSTEM PROPERTY. Traceability: Property PROP-CRITICAL-004-MINTING-AUTHORIZATION -> System-wide. zERC20.mint() restricted to minter(). zERC20.teleport() restricted to verifier(). Both roles set by owner at deployment.

checklist.title: CRITICAL: Verify all zERC20 values constrained to BN254 scalar field
checklist.description: Verify that all zERC20 values are constrained to <= 2^248-1 to maintain compatibility with BN254 scalar field used in ZK circuits. Values exceeding this limit must revert.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate MAX_VALUE constant in zERC20 (should be 2^248 - 1)
2. Locate _afterTokenTransfer hook value check
3. Verify check applies to recipient balance after ALL operations
4. Test mint pushing balance to MAX_VALUE -> success
5. Test mint pushing balance to MAX_VALUE + 1 -> revert with ValueTooLarge
checklist.notes: CRITICAL SYSTEM PROPERTY. Traceability: Property PROP-CRITICAL-005-VALUE-CONSTRAINT -> System-wide. BN254 scalar field constraint (2^248-1). _afterTokenTransfer hook enforces on ALL transfers including mint/teleport. Exceeding limit reverts with ValueTooLarge.

checklist.title: Verify Adaptor SelfCall-protected functions reject external calls
checklist.description: Verify that unwrapSelf, bridgeUnderlyingTokenSelf, and bridgeZerc20Self functions are protected by onlySelfCall modifier and reject all external caller attempts.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate unwrapSelf, bridgeUnderlyingTokenSelf, bridgeZerc20Self functions in Adaptor
2. Verify each has onlySelfCall modifier
3. Test external call to each function -> revert with SelfCallNotAllowed
4. Test call without enableSelfCall -> revert with SelfCallNotAllowed
5. Verify only internal flow via enableSelfCall succeeds
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-SUBGRAPH-ADAPTOR-SELFCALL-001 -> Subgraph GRAPH-ADAPTOR-SELFCALL-FUNCTIONS. Adaptor-specific SelfCall usage. onlySelfCall requires dual condition: msg.sender == address(this) AND _isSelfCallAllowed flag.

checklist.title: Verify Adaptor withdraw() correctly handles all token types
checklist.description: Verify that Adaptor.withdraw() correctly transfers zERC20, underlying tokens, and native ETH to users, zeroing balances before transfer to prevent reentrancy.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate withdraw() function in Adaptor
2. Verify checks-effects-interactions pattern for each token type
3. Verify balances are zeroed BEFORE transfer calls
4. Test withdraw with zERC20 balance -> correct transfer
5. Test withdraw with underlying balance -> correct transfer
6. Test withdraw with native balance -> correct transfer via _debitCombinedNativeBalance
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-ADAPTOR-BALANCE-TRACKING-001 -> Subgraph GRAPH-ADAPTOR-WITHDRAW. Balances from failed compose operations. Checks-effects-interactions pattern required.

checklist.title: Verify IncentiveLib._validateFeeParams rejects invalid parameters
checklist.description: Verify that _validateFeeParams correctly rejects: zero target liquidity, excessive target liquidity, excessive k value, and overflow-inducing parameter combinations.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate _validateFeeParams function in IncentiveLib
2. Verify check: targetLiquidity > 0
3. Verify check: targetLiquidity <= MAX_TARGET_LIQUIDITY
4. Verify check: k <= K_BPS_DENOM (10000)
5. Verify check: k * T * T does not overflow
6. Test each invalid parameter case -> revert InvalidFeeParams
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-SUBGRAPH-INCENTIVE-VALIDATION-001 -> Subgraph GRAPH-INCENTIVE-VALIDATION. Prevents division by zero, overflow, and excessive fees.

checklist.title: Verify IncentiveLib handles mathematical edge cases correctly
checklist.description: Verify that IncentiveLib produces correct results for edge cases: L=0 (max incentive), L=T (zero incentive), L>T (zero incentive clamped), amount=0 (zero result).
detection_procedure: 1. Test computeIncentive with L=0 -> returns maximum incentive
2. Test computeIncentive with L=T -> returns zero
3. Test computeIncentive with L>T -> returns zero (clamped)
4. Test computeIncentive with amount=0 -> returns zero
5. Verify integration bounds correctly clamped to [0, T]

executable_checks.assertion: All edge cases return correct values
No edge case produces unexpected results

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-INCENTIVE-EDGE-CASES-001 -> Subgraph GRAPH-INCENTIVE-CURVE. Density function ρ(x) = k × (1 - x/T). L >= T implies zero density region.

checklist.title: Verify enableSelfCall reverts when already enabled
checklist.description: Verify that calling enableSelfCall() when _isSelfCallAllowed is already true reverts with SelfCallAlreadyEnabled error.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate enableSelfCall function in SelfCall.sol
2. Verify precondition check: require(_isSelfCallAllowed == false)
3. Test nested enableSelfCall call -> revert SelfCallAlreadyEnabled
4. Verify flag correctly reset after protected function returns
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-SELFCALL-ALREADY-ENABLED-001 -> Node ACTION-ENABLE-SELFCALL. Prevents nested SelfCall patterns that could corrupt state.

checklist.title: Verify LiquidityManager receive() only accepts ETH for native underlying
checklist.description: Verify that LiquidityManager.receive() checks _isNativeUnderlying flag and reverts with NativeTokenNotSupported when underlying is not native ETH.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate receive() function in LiquidityManager
2. Verify check: require(_isNativeUnderlying, NativeTokenNotSupported)
3. Test ETH send to non-native LiquidityManager -> revert NativeTokenNotSupported
4. Test ETH send to native LiquidityManager -> accepted
5. Verify nonReentrant modifier applied to receive()

executable_checks.assertion: ETH to non-native LM reverts with NativeTokenNotSupported
ETH to native LM is accepted

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-SUBGRAPH-LM-RECEIVE-NATIVE-001 -> Subgraph GRAPH-LM-RECEIVE-NATIVE. Prevents ETH from being stuck in non-WETH LiquidityManager deployments.

checklist.title: Verify LiquidityManager maintains underlyingBalance >= feeSurplus invariant
checklist.description: Verify that LiquidityManager always maintains sufficient underlying balance to cover fee surplus, ensuring withdrawRewards never fails and unwrap correctly checks available liquidity.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate unwrap() liquidity check in LiquidityManager
2. Verify check: amount <= underlyingBalance - feeSurplus
3. Verify feeSurplus correctly incremented on each unwrap
4. Verify withdrawRewards cannot exceed feeSurplus
5. Test unwrap exceeding available liquidity -> revert
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-LM-BALANCE-CONSISTENCY-001 -> Node STATE-UNWRAP-FAILED-INSUFFICIENT-LIQUIDITY. Solvency invariant ensuring protocol can always pay accumulated fees to owner.

checklist.title: Verify IMintableBurnableERC20 implementation enforces onlyMinter
checklist.description: Verify that zERC20's implementation of IMintableBurnableERC20 (mint and burn functions) correctly restricts calls to the authorized minter address (LiquidityManager).
detection_procedure: 1. Locate mint() and burn() functions in zERC20
2. Verify onlyMinter modifier on both functions
3. Verify minter() returns LiquidityManager address
4. Test mint from non-minter -> revert
5. Test burn from non-minter -> revert

executable_checks.assertion: mint and burn have onlyMinter restriction

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-INTERFACE-MINTABLE-BURNABLE-001 -> Data structure DATA-MINTABLE-BURNABLE-INTERFACE. IMintableBurnableERC20 interface authorization. Critical for minting security.

checklist.title: Verify _removeStargateDust handles localDecimals < sharedDecimals correctly
checklist.description: Verify that Adaptor._removeStargateDust() returns 0 when localDecimals < sharedDecimals (preventing underflow in conversionRate calculation), and that all callers (quoteFee, _executeBridge) properly handle this edge case.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate _removeStargateDust function in Adaptor.sol
2. Verify check: if (localDecimals < sharedDecimals) return 0
3. Verify quoteFee() handles 0 return: returns tokenBridgeFee = amountAfterUnwrap
4. Verify _executeBridge() handles 0 return: reverts with OutputTooLow(0, minAmountOut)
5. Test with token having decimals < sharedDecimals (e.g., 4 decimals vs 6 sharedDecimals)
6. Confirm no underflow in: 10 ** uint256(localDecimals - sharedDecimals)

executable_checks.assertion: Token with decimals < sharedDecimals returns 0 and callers handle correctly
quoteFee returns tokenBridgeFee = amountAfterUnwrap when dust removal returns 0

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-ADAPTOR-STARGATE-DUST-001 -> Node ACTION-ADAPTOR-EXECUTE-BRIDGE. Stargate uses sharedDecimals (typically 6) for cross-chain compatibility. Tokens with fewer decimals cannot be bridged safely.
